headline: Weak print due to the festive shift; FY27 guidance remains intact

highlights: Primary volumes in Jul-Aug’26 grew 11-12% (excluding the recovery of the 1QFY27 billing loss), while Sep’26 saw a sharper decline as distributors deferred festive inventory build-up.

Management retained its double-digit volume growth guidance for FY27 (5.6% in 1HFY27), aided by festive stocking, new launches, and marketing initiatives. ◼ GM contracted 270bp YoY to 57.2% (est. 58.5%, 57.2% in 1QFY27) due to inflation in cotton and synthetic products.

PAGE absorbed part of the cost pressure through strategic sourcing and supply-chain initiatives and implemented a calibrated 2.5% price hike in May to partly offset RM inflation. ◼ EBITDA margin contracted 80bp YoY to 20.8%.
valuation: Per (%) -27/-18/-20 12M Avg Val (INR M) 1071 Financials & Valuations (INR b) Y/E March 2026 2027E 2028E Sales 52.5 59.3 65.8 Sales Gr.

Management clarified that the company is now fully compliant and expects no operational impact. ◼ PAGE’s performance in 1HFY27 was below our expectation; however, management continues to target double-digit volume growth in FY27 (implied mid-teen growth in 2HFY27).
watch: While RM inflation remains a near-term margin headwind, calibrated pricing and expected normalization in input costs should support profitability going forward.

The company restricted online sales of imported goods to Jockey products, while Speedo is now operated through a third-party franchisee and is no longer sold directly by the company to consumers. ▪ The total amount involved in the contravention is estimated at approximately INR480mn, cumulatively over the last 12 years (2014-15 to 2026).
